activity_summary: You came down at about seven into a house that had been working since six. Joan called your feet a disgrace to the family. She did not make a speech of it, and you did not either.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came down, and did not argue the feet.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the bread was cut, and told you to sit.

facets.activity: Came down and heard Joan call the feet a disgrace

quotes.speaker: joan_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thy feet are a disgrace to the family, brother
